steps.en: Copy the sample compose file, set your instance URL, and start the API container
steps.zh: 复制示例 compose 文件，填上实例地址，启动 API 容器

steps.en: Build the static web frontend pointed at that API
steps.zh: 构建静态 Web 前端，指向这个 API

steps.en: Paste a public post link into the page (or POST it to the API)
steps.zh: 把公开帖子的链接粘进页面（或 POST 给 API）

steps.en: Matches the link to a service and extracts the media streams
steps.zh: 识别链接属于哪个站点，抽出媒体流

steps.en: Answers redirect, tunnel or picker; a tunnel streams the file through, remuxed by ffmpeg, without caching
steps.zh: 回给你直链或多选列表，或由它中转文件，不留缓存

value.en: Anyone on your network gets a file from a link in one paste — no CLI install, no ads, on an instance you control
value.zh: 网络里任何人粘一次链接就拿到文件——不用装 CLI，没有广告，实例在你手里

sources: https://github.com/imputnet/cobalt/blob/main/docs/run-an-instance.md (docker compose up -d, sample compose with API_URL, watchtower)
https://github.com/imputnet/cobalt/blob/main/web/README.md (static SvelteKit + Vite build, WEB_DEFAULT_API required, pnpm run build)
https://github.com/imputnet/cobalt#ethics ('never caches any content', works like a proxy); api/README.md (ffmpeg for muxing/encoding)
